title: WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents
abstract: WebShop is a large-scale interactive web-based environment for language understanding and decision making, where an agent needs to find and purchase a product according to specifications provided in a natural language instruction. We train autonomous agents to complete tasks on this benchmark and achieve a task success rate of 29%, outperforming rule-based heuristics but still lower than human expert performance.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're shopping online, and you need to find a specific product. You would search, click on links, and read descriptions to find the right one. WebShop is like that, but for language agents.

We want to teach these agents to understand human language and make decisions like humans do.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
In WebShop, an agent receives a text instruction and needs to navigate through multiple web pages to find the right product. The agent can search, click on links, and read descriptions to make decisions.

We use a combination of reinforcement learning and imitation learning to train the agents.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
Our best agent achieves a task success rate of 29%, outperforming rule-based heuristics (9.6%) but still lower than human expert performance (59%).

We use two evaluation metrics: Task Score and Success Rate.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
WebShop has the potential to alleviate human efforts in tedious tasks like online shopping.

Our work demonstrates the practical potential of developing agents that can operate autonomously on the web.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
WebShop is a large-scale interactive web-based environment that combines realistic text and image content with a rich and diverse interaction space.

Our approach uses a combination of reinforcement learning and imitation learning to train agents.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
We provide a convenient OpenAI Gym environment for WebShop, allowing you to train and evaluate your own agents.

Try it out and see how well your agent can perform in the WebShop environment!
